metadata.notes: Baseline for sift-email after it gained support for several Gmail accounts sharing one rubric: each account keeps its own sift-email/state-<account>.md with an Account: line, found from the authuser in a get_thread or get_message viewUrl, or else from the sender of the newest sent mail; an older state.md is moved with git mv when one of its threads is in this account; and a Labels row whose label this account lacks is kept, with the label created when a thread fits the row. Evals 1-40, two runs each, with run-mcp-trials.sh against the Gmail and Contacts stubs and the fake GitHub, on SKILL.md as of branch sift-email-multi-account, run in parallel with separate trial directories under $TMPDIR, on 2026-10-27. The Gmail stub returns authuser viewUrls (view_url_style), and every fixture's state file is renamed to state-pat@example.com.md with an Account line. Evals 38 (a second account shares the rubric), 39 (account from sent mail), and 40 (an older state file moved to the account's) are new. Failures: eval 28 both runs kept the older template's Important, Needs reply, Sifted, and Wrong rows, since rows for labels the account lacks now stay (a known regression, accepted), and run 2 wrote a changelog line in the first person; first-person changelog lines in evals 1 run 1, 5 run 1, 18 run 2, and 40 run 2, and a first-person rubric quote in eval 32 run 1's reply; eval 39 run 1 took the account from a thread's to field without searching in:sent; eval 2 run 2 searched contacts by the coach's domain, not address or name; eval 6 run 2 and eval 10 run 1 added CATEGORY_PERSONAL to t-asked; eval 10 run 2 read the gh stub's cassette instead of making the ownership call; eval 15 run 2 left 21 changelog entries; eval 16 run 2 labeled Gmail's important marketing Bulk, not Junk; eval 23 run 2 put an order number in a commit message. Not graded: some trials read harness files in the run directory (gh-cassette.json, gh-calls.log, github-seed.json); a few commits lacked the co-author line; some runs added a duplicate Statement row.
